sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Collect both green blocks
seg = current_frame.segmentation
green_blocks = []
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'N':
        rows = [p[0] for p in n['boundary']]
        cols = [p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
        center_row = (min(rows) + max(rows)) // 2
        center_col = (min(cols) + max(cols)) // 2
        green_blocks.append((center_row, center_col))

print(f"Green blocks to collect: {green_blocks}")
for row, col in green_blocks:
    result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': row, 'col': col}])
    print(f"MOUSE at ({row},{col}): level_completed={result.get('level_completed')}")

# Check remaining green blocks
seg = current_frame.segmentation
green_count = sum(1 for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N')
print(f"Remaining green: {green_count}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
